subject: *: support for partition table and common handle for index lookup push down (#64839)
summary:
Reviewed this commit vs its first parent with focus on `pkg/planner/`, `pkg/executor/`, and `pkg/store/` behavior. Change enables index lookup pushdown for (1) partitioned tables with local indexes by rewriting pushed-down `TableScan.TableId` to each partition physical ID at request build time, and (2) common-handle tables by emitting an `IndexLookUp` executor with empty `IndexHandleOffsets` and updating mock coprocessor handling.

Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: a correctness issue around int-handle offset selection when extra negative-ID columns (e.g. `ExtraPhysTblID` for UnionScan/uncommitted rows on partitioned tables) were appended was fixed later in `ce06e5d382` (#65157). With that follow-up in place, no remaining Blocker/High issues found.
